Reach your smart home, NAS & co. on the go – no subscription, no cost, no account with us. You use your own tunnel: WireGuard or Tailscale.

• Mobile data → tunnel right away.
• On Wi-Fi the app briefly knocks on the address directly (max. 0.8 s). Answer → you're at home, the page loads directly and the app remembers this Wi-Fi.
• On other Wi-Fi networks it then uses the tunnel right away, without knocking first. If the tunnel fails there, it tries the direct route after all (e.g. new router).
• If loading directly fails, it switches to the tunnel by itself.
The app recognizes the Wi-Fi by address range, router address and domain – not by the Wi-Fi name, which Android only reveals with location permission.

• WireGuard: straight from the phone to your router (e.g. FRITZ!Box with FRITZ!OS 7.50 or later), nobody in between. The router must be reachable from outside – via its own IPv4 or via IPv6.\n• Tailscale: for connections without their own IP (DS-Lite, many fiber/cable lines) or other Wi-Fi networks without IPv6. At home you need a Tailscale device as subnet router. Sign-in runs through the Tailscale service (free for personal use) or your own Headscale server.

The tunnel runs only inside this app and only for your home addresses. Other apps and the rest of the internet notice nothing – another VPN can run at the same time. After closing, the tunnel shuts down after 90 s.

WireGuard keys and passwords are stored encrypted (Android Keystore), the Tailscale device key in the app\'s protected storage. Nothing is uploaded: no logs, no ads, no data collection. Optional fingerprint before opening.
